name: emoji and astral-plane names round-trip byte for byte; a remote backslash name is listed and stays on the drive
description: KOOFR-011 (Koofr API and desktop): a backslash was replaced by U+FF3C, invalid UTF-8 replaced, emoji refused as 'Invalid filename', Google Drive names given U+FFFD plus a random suffix. Rules P4, S8 and O1: names are kept byte for byte; emoji and astral-plane characters are valid everywhere; a backslash or invalid UTF-8 is refused and listed per file, never mapped silently. sync-chaos port-control-chars.
